title: TheForestDedicatedServerConfig
description: Comprehensive schema and insights definition for The Forest Dedicated Server deployed on Azure with Docker and Wine.

serverIP.description: Internal IP address for the game server process. Typically 0.0.0.0 in Docker.

serverSteamPort.description: UDP port used by Steam communication services.

serverGamePort.description: UDP port used for direct player gameplay communication.

serverQueryPort.description: UDP port used by Steam Server Browser and queries to retrieve player count and ping.

serverName.description: Display name of the server visible in The Forest multiplayer lobby and Steam master server browser.

serverPlayers.description: Maximum number of simultaneous players supported by The Forest dedicated server engine.

serverPassword.description: Join password required for players to connect. Leave blank for an open public server.

serverPasswordAdmin.description: Administrative password used to execute in-game console commands and server moderation.

serverSteamAccount.description: Steam Game Server Login Token (GSLT) registered at https://steamcommunity.com/dev/managegameservers with AppID 242760.

serverAutoSaveInterval.description: Interval between automatic game world saves in minutes (minimum 15, default 30).

difficulty.description: Game difficulty setting affecting survival, enemy health, and hunger/thirst depletion.

initType.description: Whether the server starts a fresh game world or continues from existing save slot.

slot.description: The active save game slot on the server disk (1 through 5).

showLogs.description: Show event logs on standard output.

serverContact.description: Contact email address of the server administrator.

veganMode.description: Disables all cannibals and mutants for a pure building and survival experience.

vegetarianMode.description: Cannibals and mutants spawn only during the night; daytime is peaceful.

resetHolesMode.description: Resets structural cutouts/holes when reloading the save game.

treeRegrowMode.description: Regrows 10% of cut-down tree stumps every time players sleep.

allowBuildingDestruction.description: Allows mutants and cannibals to damage and destroy player-built structures.

allowEnemiesCreativeMode.description: Enables enemies even if running in creative game mode.

allowCheats.description: Allows clients to use the built-in developer debug console.

realisticPlayerDamage.description: Enables full unscaled friendly-fire weapon damage in PvP encounters.

targetFpsIdle.description: Target server tickrate/FPS when no players are connected (0 = adaptive).

targetFpsActive.description: Target server tickrate/FPS when at least one player is active (0 = adaptive).

azureInsights.description: Cloud infrastructure metadata and real telemetry schema.
